{{Cat main|Aggression}}

'''Aggression''' in [[psychology]] and other [[social science|social]] and [[behavioral science]]s,  refers to behavior that is intended to cause harm or pain. Aggression can be either physical or verbal. Behavior that accidentally causes harm or pain is not aggression. Property damage and other destructive behavior may also fall under the definition of aggression.
